subject: The secret mistake 92% of couples make on Day 7
preview_text: I wasn't going to share this confession, but one user's story changed everything about avoiding the routine trap.
body_paragraphs: I got an email last week that stopped me cold. A user named Sarah wrote, 'Anas, we downloaded SoulPlan a week ago. We were excited. Then life happened. We got busy. We forgot. It’s Day 7 and we’re already slipping back into 'what do you want to do?' 'I don't know.' Sound familiar?'

Here’s the truth she discovered. The couples who keep the spark alive don't just save ideas for 'someday.' They act before the 7-day mark. Sarah and her partner felt the routine creeping back in. So they opened the app that night and used the Surprise Date Planner. One planned, one got surprised with a simple, budget-friendly picnic idea the AI generated. Sarah said it wasn't about the grand gesture. It was the signal: 'I’m still choosing us.' That small act broke the cycle.

That’s the power hidden in your app right now. The Surprise Date Planner isn't just a feature. It’s a hack to short-circuit the 'routine talk' before it starts. It forces one beautiful, simple action that says 'you're worth planning for' louder than any fancy dinner.

Don't let Day 7 be the day you forget. Be the partner who plans the surprise tonight. Open SoulPlan, tap 'Surprise Date,' and pick one idea for this week. P.S. The 92% who say their relationship improved? They all did this one thing first: they used a feature within the first 10 days. Your 10 days are almost up.
